This '''individual''' was an associate of the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Marka Durn]]. When Durn tried to extort the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Xishel]] for more [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the scout was shot by a [[Unidentified Wookiee pirate|Wookiee pirate]] and fled from the encounter. Durn encountered his associate, confiding the location of some treasure, just before [[Death/Legends|dying]].<ref name="The Treasure of Celis Mott">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=The Treasure of Celis Mott}}</ref>
